title: Thirteen reports from one template

steps.say: The render script is the pipeline: walk() calls quarto_render() once per region. Start with three and check them before you run all 13.
Add Northern Borders and read its file name: a space. Spaces break links, e-mail attachments and the next script that reads this folder.
Build the file name from the region with stringr: lower case, hyphens for spaces. report-northern-borders.pdf is safe everywhere.
Read the regions from regions.csv. Each PDF has its own title and wording, because both come from the parameter. Add a region to the file and its PDF appears.

final:
library(tidyverse)

regions <- read_csv("regions.csv") |> pull(region_en)

walk(regions, \(r) {
  slug <- r |> str_to_lower() |> str_replace_all(" ", "-")
  quarto::quarto_render(
    "report.qmd",
    output_format = "typst",
    execute_params = list(region = r),
    output_file = str_glue("report-{slug}.pdf")
  )
})
